newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares up on foreign gains, upside seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares up on foreign gains, upside seen.

text.p: Austrian shares got off to a robust week's start, following strong leads from Germany and the United States, and traders predicted the market would remain friendly in the next few days.
"Vienna profited from the dollar and the Dax, but was relatively restrained in comparison," one trader said.
Dealers said the market was well-supported at 1,180 points and further gains were likely to be modest.
The market is seen rangebound between 1,180 and 1,200 points over the coming days.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips climbed 10.49 points or 0.9 percent to 1,178.29. Among its constituents 16 shares rose and five fell.
The top gainer was fireproof maker Radex-Heraklith, rising 4.69 percent to 458 schillings.

Creditanstalt preferred added 3.2 schillings to 454.80, while CA ordinaries rose 4.2 schillings to 721.10 after the bank said it would raise its 1996 dividend to 12 schillings/share from 10 schillings/share.
Austrian microchip maker AMS led the decliners, falling 2.44 percent to 1,000 schillings.
The April ATX future gained 11.5 points to 1,179.0 on turnover of 539 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 257
